findings.issue: In 電話くれれば, くれる is the main (and only) verb of the clause, 'give (me) a call' with を dropped — not an auxiliary attached to a て-form. Labeling it 'verbo auxiliar' contradicts the corpus role convention (cf. み in 聞いてみた) and the item's own explanation.
findings.suggested: verbo principal (benefactivo: dar/fazer para o falante)

findings.issue: Mangled punctuation at the end: closing quote and period are inside the parenthesis — "(quem é?'.)" — leaving the quote opened before 'aquele' unclosed properly.
findings.current: destacar a informação buscada: 'aquele que inventou o telefone (quem é?'.)
findings.suggested: destacar a informação buscada: 'aquele que inventou o telefone' (quem é?).

findings.issue: In the parenthetical gloss, 'tomara que logo virem' is ungrammatical: after 'tomara que' the verb needs present subjunctive ('venham'/'cheguem'); 'virem' is the personal infinitive of 'vir' (or 3pl of 'virar', which cannot take 'férias' as subject).
findings.current: Ah, cedo férias-de-verão em não-vira, será? (= tomara que logo virem)
findings.suggested: Ah, cedo férias-de-verão em não-vira, será? (= tomara que cheguem logo)
